# Film fixture project

The minimal film project later film tickets start from: "Tessarine launch", 16:9, 20 s, brand `tessarine` (the demo brand id; the library entry comes from `--brand demo:tessarine` or a test), theme not picked. `plan/brief.json` is a complete brief written with `mf-motion film brief --set ... --check`; `plan/brief.md` is its rendering. Copy the folder before running commands against it.
